field.label: Report changes to Centraliza
field.comment: Turns Centraliza on for this website. One website at a time: every setting of this section is read at the scope of the website set to Yes, and Default Config is only what websites inherit.

field.label: Mode
field.comment: In simulation, each request is written to var/log/centraliza_connector_dry_run.jsonl instead of being sent.

field.label: Environment
field.comment: Each environment keeps its own API key and channel ID: switching uses the pair saved for it.

field.label: API key
field.comment: Production workspace key (csk_...), from app.centraliza.ai > Settings > API keys.

field.label: Channel ID
field.comment: UUID of the Magento channel, from app.centraliza.ai > Settings > Channels.

field.label: API key
field.comment: Staging workspace key (csk_...), from app.centraliza.dev > Settings > API keys.

field.label: Channel ID
field.comment: UUID of the Magento channel, from app.centraliza.dev > Settings > Channels.

field.label: Status
field.comment: Checks the key of this website's saved environment. Save the configuration first after changing the environment.

field.label: Debug Log
field.comment: Writes one line per message request to Centraliza (method, path, status and error) to var/log/centraliza.log. Errors are written there whatever this setting. Turn it on while investigating and off afterwards.

field.label: Report guest carts
field.comment: When No, a cart is reported only once it belongs to a customer.

field.label: Maximum attempts
field.comment: How many times an event is sent while Centraliza is unavailable. Each failure waits longer before the next try; the last one moves the event to quarantine, where it stays until someone reviews it.

field.label: Request Limit Per Minute
field.comment: Requests per minute Centraliza allows each API key, counted together for the connection events and the order and cart messages; 60 is the limit measured so far. 0 turns the local limit off: only Centraliza's own answer (429) holds requests back. While the legacy Centraliza modules are enabled, a value above 60 counts as 60: they keep their own limit of 60 in the same count.

field.label: Requests Kept For Messages
field.comment: Connection events stop for the minute when this many requests of the limit are left. From 21 to one under the limit, so they always stop before abandoned-cart reminders, which stop with 20 left.

group.label: Order Notifications
group.comment: WhatsApp messages about the order status, sent by Centraliza (order.status_updated). They use the connection above, of the website that reports.

field.label: Send Order Created and Origin Cart
field.comment: For orders placed from a cart a Centraliza link opened: sends the order.created event and adds the cart to their status events. Keep it off until Centraliza confirms it accepts both.

field.label: Notified statuses
field.comment: Order statuses that notify the customer. A status missing from this table produces no notification.

field.label: Give up after (hours)
field.comment: A notification still waiting to be sent (postponed or in the backlog) this many hours after it was created is marked failed. Resends themselves are capped by the attempt limit.

field.label: Maximum send attempts
field.comment: Counts every send of a notification, including the first. When the last one fails, the notification is marked failed. Allowed: 1 to 10.

group.label: Abandoned Cart
group.comment: Reminders of the carts logged-in customers left behind (cart.abandoned), for Centraliza's WhatsApp recovery automations. They use the connection above, of the website that reports. Nothing is sent while Centraliza_Sales is enabled.

field.label: Cart Abandonment Time (minutes)
field.comment: How long the customer must stay inactive before the message. Changing the cart, opening the cart or the checkout page and logging in all count as activity and restart this wait; browsing the catalogue does not. E.g. 60 = one hour after the last activity; 0 = next run, for tests.

field.label: Skip Carts Idle for More Than (minutes)
field.comment: A cart with no activity for longer than this gets no message, so the customer is not reminded of something old. Counted from the last activity, not from the last change: a cart the customer opened today is not idle, however old its contents are. E.g. 1440 = 24 hours; 0 = no limit (up to 30 days, when Magento deletes the cart).

field.label: Total Notifications per Cart
field.comment: How many messages the same cart can generate, the first included. A new one goes out when the customer comes back after the last message — changing an item or just opening the cart or the checkout again — and then stays away for the abandonment time. E.g. 3 = the first and up to 2 resends; 1 = only one; 0 = no limit, so a customer who keeps coming back keeps being reminded.

group.label: Cart Recovery Link
group.comment: While Centraliza_Sales is enabled, the link is answered by the legacy module with its own setting.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Accepts the /centraliza/cart_redirect/?cart_id= link generated by Centraliza and opens the cart Centraliza created as the customer's cart.
